description.value: Yoko Sushi is a neighborhood sushi restaurant on Austin Avenue in Coquitlam, serving freshly made-to-order Japanese food. The restaurant offers both dine-in and online ordering for takeout, making it a convenient stop for cyclists looking for a quick, fresh meal. It sits in a residential-commercial strip in central Coquitlam.
